name: The Anointed
description: Mummified caretakers who keep performing their duties despite the chaos.

timeline.summary: Temmet leads them through the city, where they see people training and the Anointed doing all labor.
timeline.quote: "The Anointed perform all the work here, so the living need do nothing but train.

timeline.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
timeline.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra walk through Naktamun, noting that everyone is a trainee under twenty and mummies do all the labor.
timeline.quote: The enchanted dead were the ones who did all the work.

timeline.summary: Bontu commands Gideon to leave her temple, and he exits and realizes the anointed are the remnants of fallen initiates.
timeline.quote: The anointed are the remnants of initiates fallen in battle.

timeline.summary: Hazoret curses Samut and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
The dragon raises the enchanted dead as caretakers and repurposes an elite sacrificial ceremony into the endless Trials, setting the second sun to move on his schedule.
timeline.quote: He spelled the second sun to move as he was ready

timeline.summary: Hapatra leads the beasts of the Holding out against the mummies and locusts, cutting down the dead with her poisoned scimitar.
timeline.quote: With every swipe of her blade, another mummy halted, hunched over, and fell to the earth

pages_say.description: Mummified dead who do all the labor in the city.
Enchanted mummies that perform all labor.
The mummified dead who serve the city; Gideon realizes they are initiates fallen in battle.
Mummified dead servants who hunt Samut and obey the gods.
The enchanted dead raised by the dragon to care for the orphaned infants.
Mummified caretakers who keep performing their duties despite the chaos.
